counter_arguments: The PR only renames a function and moves retry logic to a new module; it does not modify the code that caps charge amounts at 50000 cents.
The revisit condition for the workaround is the completion of ledger migration to bigint (PAY-240). The PR does not reference or depend on that migration.
No changes are made to the anchor code block that performs the capping, nor is there any removal of the conditional check.
The PR's description and diff focus on module organization and naming, not on fixing the overflow issue that the workaround addresses.
Even if the retry logic were related to charge processing, it does not affect the amount capping logic required to prevent integer overflow.
reasoning: The workaround HACK-008 is specifically about capping charge amounts to avoid overflow in a downstream ledger until a bigint migration occurs. The PR under review merely reorganizes billing modules, renames a function, and moves retry logic; it makes no changes to the capping logic, does not address the ledger migration condition, and does not remove or replace the conditional that enforces the 50000‑cent limit. Therefore, the PR does not resolve the underlying condition required to retire the workaround.
